GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Settled Down Two Wide 6th, 4.5 Lengths @ 1100m. Off Mid-Field Ridden Along into Straight . Just Held Ground in Straight # never a real threat

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Six Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 250m & only held ground in last 200m. # Fair effort.
Jumped Ok Settled Down 9th 8 Lengths 800m 10th 10 Lengths home turn Under Pressure 10th Middle Of Track only held ground Straight # back/average run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Blundered on jumping. Passing the 1100m was steadied after improving onto heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 5l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off all clear, found little, dropped out # poor
Jumped Ok s/d 7th 6 Lengths 1200m 7th 6 Lengths 800m 6th 5 Lengths 600m 3 Wide Hard Ridden home turn 7th Under Pressure weakened badly final 300m # weak/tired 300m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr: obtained an off-pace position one off the fence and travelled comfortably throughout the early and middle stages. Approaching the home turn, came under pressure and failed to respond to its rider’s riding before weakening in the home straight. In the opinion of the rider, the gelding, which was carrying a heavy weight impost, failed to run out a strong 1808m. Trainer agreed. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

[Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # solid win
